name: project-activity
goal: The analytics page of a Harness site is about the application it is hosted for: it names the repository, shows the loop types the project uses, its recent committed work with reasons and the files that changed with their components, the uncommitted changes of each checkout apart from that, and how many registered agents are working now and on which components, from a registration with heartbeats that says honestly when it does not know; the same recorded activity is built into the history index and shown by an installed console without Git or a database, where live activity is said to be unavailable

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: The analytics page counted the hosting repository's events already but called itself the local harness, showed machine CPU, and had no recent work, files, loop types or agents. Success: the page names the repository; before the totals it shows registered agents working now with their stated provider, model, checkout, task, loop and units, loop types with outcomes, recent commits with noted reasons and links to their console page, changed files with components, and uncommitted changes of each checkout apart from committed work; everything is read server-side for the repository of the site and its worktrees; an agent is working only while its own heartbeat is fresh, an end is final, a gone or reused process is not the agent, and where nobody registered the number is unknown; the same committed activity is built into the history index and shown by an installed console, where live activity is said to be absent; every endpoint stays behind the owner policy. Proof: contract tests through the public command line, a history build, the console access and installer, component rendering, a browser spec at three widths, the whole browser suite and bun run check.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: New units: function.activity-types, function.agent-liveness, function.agent-statement, function.loop-usage, function.unit-owners, function.project-activity, adapter.process-identity, repository.agent-registry, repository.project-work, service.agent-activity, service.project-activity, workflow.run-activity, command.activity, guide.activity; in the site reports.function.site-activity, reports.endpoint.api-project-activity, reports.function.activity-display, reports.component.project-activity, activity-agents, activity-loops, activity-work, activity-files, harness-harness-activity and harness-harness-tabs. Changed: the history build writes activity.json; the console access, bundling, host files and routes know it and the activity view; the analytics page and the console show it; any Harness command of an agent named by HARNESS_AGENT_ID is a heartbeat. Registrations live under .cache/harness/agents of the checkout an agent works in: three files per agent, each written whole, an end created only once. AGENTS.md, harness info activity and the feature specification say how an agent registers. Existing shared stores are unchanged.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Red on the unchanged product at 37e96d2: work/activity/logs/core-RED.log (test/utils/agent-liveness.test.ts could not load; test/activity-agents.e2e.test.ts 7 failed; test/activity-project.e2e.test.ts 5 failed; test/history-activity.e2e.test.ts 3 failed; the new test of test/console-host-routes.e2e.test.ts failed with 404), work/activity/logs/reports-unit-RED.log (packages/reports/test/components/project-activity.test.ts could not load) and work/activity/logs/browser-RED.log (packages/reports/tests/e2e/project-activity.spec.ts 10 failed) with before screenshots in work/activity/red/screenshots-before. Hashes of the test files and logs: work/activity/red/red-test-hashes.txt and red-log-hashes.txt. Two of the files had mistakes of their own found while going green (a section helper and a type cast in the component test, then a helper the audit counted as one long function; a list name that also matched Uncommitted files in the browser spec): each was corrected and its red run again on product code set back to HEAD in place, so the recorded reds are of the final files. Green with the same files: 22 core tests, 4 component tests, 10 browser tests at desktop, tablet and mobile. One existing browser test named the four views of the console and now names five; every assertion it had is kept and applies to the fifth.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: bun run check exit 0 on the final working tree (work/activity/logs/check-4.log): 465 unit tests with 25 live-API tests skipped, 187 command-line end-to-end tests in 57 files, 27 package tests with 3 scale tests skipped (the installed console with its Activity view and activity.json behind the host policy among them), the three browser-run tests with 5 passed, 136 reports unit tests in 59 files, audit and registry check passed (573 units, 16 uncertain references as before). Earlier checks are kept: check-1 failed because one existing browser test named four console views and there are five now; check-2 and check-3 passed before two last display corrections. Whole browser suite on the final build: 160 passed, 1 skipped as before (work/activity/logs/browser-suite-final.log); provider picker 2 passed. Screenshots after at 1440, 920 and 390 pixels were looked at: work/activity/green/screenshots-after from the fixture application, and work/activity/own-captures from this repository over GET-only reads with recording disabled, with this session registered through harness activity register. Twelve existing units are over a frozen limit and twenty-four new units have no baseline (work/activity/budget-findings.txt); no limit was changed here. The complete verification was not run; it is Codex's.

steps.title: Make the first view short, keep an open page current and honest, after independent browser review.
steps.evidence: Independent browser review found the first view far too tall on this repository (13365 pixels at a 1280 pixel window, 199 component chips, uncommitted files 5082 pixels down), an open page that never read again and so still called an exited owner working, and CPU tiles that did not say whose figures they were. Red on the product as it was then: work/activity/followup/core-RED.log (test/activity-bounds.e2e.test.ts: the moment an allowance ends was missing; its bounds test passed already), reports-unit-RED.log (activity-preview.test.ts 3 failed, activity-reading.test.ts could not load) and browser-RED.log (project-activity-live.spec.ts 6 failed). Those five files and the eight of the first round are byte for byte what they were at their reds (work/activity/followup/final-test-hashes.txt, compared with a copy of the tree taken then in /Users/danielfugere/projects/harness-activity-followup-baseline). Green: 13 component and reading tests, 16 browser tests of both activity specs, 9 core tests. Now the first view is five agents, six uncommitted and six committed files and five commits, each list with a control for the rest, a large change as counts until opened, the checkout that was asked first; the page reads again every 15 seconds while visible and on request, marks a reading it could not renew and after a minute counts nobody; each CPU tile names its scope. Measured on this repository at 1280 pixels: page 6613, activity 2294, uncommitted files at 437, 53 chips (work/activity/followup/before.json and after.json, GET only). bun run check exit 0 on the final tree (work/activity/followup/check-final-2.log): 465 unit, 204 command-line end-to-end in 61 files with the four new activity files now in the script, 27 package, 5 browser-run, 140 reports unit tests, audit and registry passed (577 units, 16 uncertain references). Whole browser suite: 166 passed, 1 skipped as before. Thirteen existing units are over a frozen limit and twenty-eight new ones have no baseline (work/activity/budget-findings.txt); no limit was changed here.
